name: Capital market law

subjectOf.text: Even if the ECJ has embraced the incorporation theory, Member States can still frustrate Type B regulatory competition through tax law, capital market law, listing requirements and other mechanisms, so the seat theory may retain de facto dominance.
subjectOf.abstract: tax law,16 capital market law17 and listing requirements18 or other mechanisms to frustrate Type B regulatory competition after ECJ's rulings in Centros and Inspire Art, the seat theory may continue its de facto dominance.

subjectOf.text: The success of Europe's experiment with Type B regulatory competition will turn largely on whether there is a clear understanding of what is corporate law and what is not.
